mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_SHIELD + i from Shield{i+1}, so Shield02.bmd is shield index 1, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Horn Shield. mu.db agrees: group 6 index 1, Item/Shield02.bmd.
why_this_one: Hanzo's, and the blacksmith is the last shop with lines missing - five of his twenty-four were built this morning. He stocks twelve shields and two were here; these five take him to seven of the twelve, in the order his shelf reads. See shared/Market.Blacksmith.
profile_from: The weapon profile, as the two built shields use, and its default material is not kept: steel there is blade steel with a directional grain, and a shield is armour. See Shield10, which records the same swap.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateShield(number, slot, skill, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, defenseRate, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). The group is not in the call: CreateArmor ends `armor.Group = (byte)(slot + 5)` and a shield's slot is 1, so the group is 6. See Shield01, which worked that out first.
stats.defense_rate_note: The shield's own block chance, which the fight does not roll yet. Recorded and unread.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 1, 0 - the Dark Knight alone.

sheet_from: Data/Item/du_shield2.OZJ (32x32), from MuMain. The .bmd names du_shield2.jpg; 26 triangles. The sheet is the partner of du_shield1, which the Small Shield wears - MU numbered the pair and the two shields are not otherwise related.
sheet_note: du_shield2 is a round shield with three black bosses set in a pale steel face and a brown rim. Mean (90, 86, 92) at chroma 13, so it is steel with a warm edge rather than a coloured shield.
material_note: Four islands: island 1 is the face at 14 triangles and islands 0, 2 and 3 are four each, the three bosses. Per triangle the face means (79, 80, 83) and the bosses (148, 149, 150), both at chroma 5 - the same steel lit differently rather than two materials. plate_steel and not the weapon profile's steel, which is the swap Shield10 records: steel is blade steel with a directional grain running along the mill, and running that across a shield face is the fault the Plate gauntlets showed. A shield is armour - hammered, curved, worn where it is hit.
material_overrides_note: 2026-09-21, from the studio sheet: the three horns (islands 0, 2, 3) are cones off the pale corner of the sheet, and as plate_steel they mirrored the sun into white bloom at noon and dusk. Steel at 0.4, as the Small Shield's spike; the face stays plate_steel.
